ResearchProjectDef.label: bionics
ResearchProjectDef.description: Replace body parts with bionics that outperform the originals. Unlocks bionic eyes, arms, legs, spines, hearts, stomachs and ears.

ResearchProjectDef.label: imperial implants
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft the Empire's brain implants and specialised limbs. Unlocks the joywire, painstopper, mindscrew, power claw, drill arm and field hand.

ResearchProjectDef.label: toxin filtration
ResearchProjectDef.description: Implant organs that filter toxins from the body. Unlocks the detoxifier lung and kidney.

ResearchProjectDef.label: cryptosleep
ResearchProjectDef.description: Suspend people in cryptosleep. Unlocks the cryptosleep casket.

ResearchProjectDef.label: growth vats
ResearchProjectDef.description: Grow embryos and children in vats. Unlocks the growth vat.

ResearchProjectDef.label: implant weapons
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft weapons built into the body. Unlocks hand talons, elbow blades, knee spikes, venom fangs and venom talons.

ResearchProjectDef.label: pulse-charged munitions
ResearchProjectDef.description: Fire charged pulses of energy. Unlocks the charge rifle and charge lance.

ResearchProjectDef.label: beam weapons
ResearchProjectDef.description: Fire continuous energy beams. Unlocks the beam repeater and beam graser.

ResearchProjectDef.label: shields
ResearchProjectDef.description: Project personal and area shields that stop projectiles. Unlocks the shield belt and broadshield pack.

ResearchProjectDef.label: recon armour
ResearchProjectDef.description: Make light powered armour. Unlocks recon armour and helmets.

ResearchProjectDef.label: marine armour
ResearchProjectDef.description: Make full powered armour. Unlocks marine armour and helmets.

ResearchProjectDef.label: cataphract armour
ResearchProjectDef.description: Make the Empire's heavy powered armour. Unlocks cataphract armour and helmets.

ResearchProjectDef.label: shuttles
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build passenger shuttles. Unlocks the passenger shuttle.

ResearchProjectDef.label: starflight basics
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build the hull of a starship, its computer core and cryptosleep caskets for the journey. Unlocks ship structure, the ship computer core and ship cryptosleep caskets.

ResearchProjectDef.label: starship drive
ResearchProjectDef.description: Power and steer a starship. Unlocks the ship engine, reactor and sensor cluster.

ResearchProjectDef.label: metabolic implants
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft the Empire's implants that rework digestion, healing and the skin. Unlocks the artificial metabolism, healing factor, molecular analysis and skin hardening implants.

ResearchProjectDef.label: neural implants
ResearchProjectDef.description: Craft the Empire's implants that reshape the mind, the sleep cycle and the face. Unlocks the neural computation, circadian influence and flesh shaping implants.

ResearchProjectDef.label: ultra mechtech
ResearchProjectDef.description: The technology needed for your mechanitor to create and control ultra-tier mechanoids.
